Andrew advises business owners, families and individuals on commercial, tax and succession matters, with a focus on achieving practical, commercially sound outcomes. His approach is solutions-focused, strategic and grounded in a deep understanding of his clients’ personal and business objectives.

Professional Background

Andrew holds a Master of Laws (Tax), a Bachelor of Laws (Honours) and a Bachelor of Commerce (Accounting). He is admitted as a solicitor of the Supreme Court of Queensland.

He has extensive experience advising on a broad range of commercial and tax matters, including business structuring, acquisitions and divestments, commercial contracts, and succession planning.

Andrew is committed to building long-term relationships with his clients, delivering clear, commercial advice that helps them move forward with confidence.
